control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, check LEFT and RIGHT obstacles: on LEFT curve left (30, 0), on RIGHT curve right (0, 30), otherwise call driveInTheDark; if not, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % without end; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10, 40); otherwise curve right (40, 10).

likely_intent.description: Drive through tunnels without hitting their walls.

scenarios.coded_response: Because LLIGHT never goes below 30 %, it takes the 30 % or more branch; in dim light below 70 % it drives forward at 30 % without reading the side obstacle sensors.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot drives in dim light inside a tunnel, with a wall in front of its left or right side in a bend, or a straight passage.
scenarios.trigger: It reaches the bend or drives along the tunnel.
scenarios.title: Does not hit the tunnel walls
assumptions: You mean the walls of a tunnel it drives through, including a bend.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from the wall and gets through the tunnel without hitting its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, a wall stands ahead across the robot's way.
scenarios.trigger: The FRONT obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall ahead in the light
assumptions: You didn't say this, but stopAtWall is meant to stop before a wall ahead.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it.

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black and right otherwise.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, no wall is ahead, and the robot is on or beside a black line.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the floor, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line in the light
assumptions: You didn't say this, but followLine is meant to follow the line.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.

You didn't say what the robot should do in bright light; stopping at a wall ahead and following the line are inferred from the program.
